info.title: SMS Document Service API
info.description:
API for managing file uploads and document storage in the School Management System.

This service provides:
- File upload functionality with automatic bucket/folder creation
- Resource management with full metadata
- File retrieval via resource ID with presigned URLs
- Path (bucket) management
- Folder management
- Integration with MinIO (S3-compatible) storage

## Authentication
All endpoints require authentication via Keycloak JWT token.
Include the token in the Authorization header as `Bearer <token>`.

## Authorization
Currently, only users with the `admin` role can access these endpoints.

## Endpoints Overview

### Sprint 1 - File Upload & Retrieval
| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `POST /v1/documents/upload` | Upload file (auto-creates path/folder) |
| `POST /v1/documents/resource` | Create resource with metadata (path/folder must exist) |
| `GET /v1/documents/resource` | List all resources |
| `GET /v1/documents/resource/{resource_id}` | Get resource by ID |
| `PUT /v1/documents/resource/{resource_id}` | Update resource metadata |
| `DELETE /v1/documents/resource/{resource_id}` | Delete resource |

### Sprint 2 - Path & Folder Management
| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `POST /v1/documents/path` | Create new path |
| `GET /v1/documents/path` | List all paths |
| `GET /v1/documents/path/{path_id}` | Get path by ID |
| `PUT /v1/documents/path/{path_id}` | Update path |
| `DELETE /v1/documents/path/{path_id}` | Delete path |
| `POST /v1/documents/folder` | Create new folder |
| `GET /v1/documents/folder` | List all folders |
| `GET /v1/documents/folder/{folder_id}` | Get folder by ID |
| `PUT /v1/documents/folder/{folder_id}` | Update folder |
| `DELETE /v1/documents/folder/{folder_id}` | Delete folder |

post.description:
Upload a file to the document storage system.

The file will be stored in MinIO with the specified path and folder.
If the path/bucket doesn't exist, it will be created automatically.

**Note:** The filename will be auto-generated (UUID-based) for storage.

params.description:
JSON string containing upload parameters.
Must include `path` and `folder` fields.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of resources with optional filtering.

## Query Parameters
- `folder_id` - Filter by folder ID
- `status` - Filter by metadata status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED)
- `page` - Page number (default: 1)
- `limit` - Items per page (default: 10, max: 100)

post.summary: Create a new resource (Upload file with metadata)
post.description:
Upload a file to the document storage system with complete metadata.

**Important:** This endpoint does NOT auto-create paths or folders.
- The path (bucket) must already exist
- The folder must already exist within the path
- If either doesn't exist, returns error with status info

This endpoint is designed for internal service usage where metadata tracking is required.

## Required Fields
- `path` - Bucket name (must exist)
- `folder` - Folder name within the path (must exist)
- `uploaded_by` - User ID or identifier of the uploader
- `file` - The file to upload

## Optional Fields
- `description` - Description of the file
- `tag_ids` - Array of tag UUIDs to associate with the file

params.description: JSON string containing upload parameters with metadata.

400.description: Bad Request - Path/folder doesn't exist or invalid parameters

value.error: path or folder does not exist: path_exists=false, folder_exists=false
path or folder does not exist: path_exists=true, folder_exists=false

get.description:
Retrieve file information and a presigned URL for accessing the file.

The presigned URL returned is temporary and will expire after a configured time period.
Use this URL to download or access the file directly.

put.description:
Update the metadata of an existing resource.

## Updatable Fields
- `description` - Update the description
- `status` - Update the status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED)
- `tag_ids` - Replace associated tags

tag_ids.description: Array of tag IDs to associate

delete.description:
Delete a resource and its associated file from storage.
This will also delete the associated metadata and tag associations.
